themes.name: AI compute: NVIDIA's supply chain
themes.what: Intel closed down 28.6% at 65.76 on Oct 30, its worst day since the 1970s, after guiding Q4 to $15 billion to $16 billion and flagging an explosion at its Israel plant worth about $600 million of revenue over two quarters (CNBC, Barchart, Massive). The Nasdaq fell 2.86% that day and the Nasdaq 100 about 6.5% in October, its worst month since March 2025. MRVL fell 10.05% to 196.40, below its buy zone, and LITE 8.57% to 840.70 with no deal announced (Massive). Amazon arranged up to $80 billion of supplier financing for its AI build (Barchart).
themes.for_you: No buys or puts in chips this week. MRVL is under its zone and sliding; LITE waits on deal terms; INTC is a falling knife. AMZN is left out of both lists: the financing keeps its suppliers paid but adds to its debt.

themes.name: AI power and the grid
themes.what: Missed earlier in the week: Vertiv's Q3 (Oct 28) sales rose 61% to about $4.3 billion, organic orders grew more than 100%, and it raised its 2026 guidance on every key metric (company release); VRT rose 16.48% that day. It gave back 5.46% on Oct 30 to 232.50 but still rose 19.65% for the week, while GEV rose 5.26% to 857.87 (Massive). The money keeps flowing to cooling and power gear even as the spenders are sold.
themes.for_you: No buy yet. VRT is 'Buy zone, wait for the chart' and closed just under its 235.93 zone floor; the up/down volume check fails. GEV is Wait. Watch VRT for a base and a close back inside the zone.

themes.name: Defense, drones and reshoring
themes.what: The US approved a $2.1 billion Patriot missile sale to Ukraine on Oct 30 (Reuters). L3Harris reported a record $53.2 billion backlog after $19.3 billion of Q3 orders, including seven year contracts of $6.3 billion for THAAD propulsion and $4.7 billion for PAC-3 MSE propulsion (Defence Industry Europe, Oct 30). For the week LHX rose 9.31%, GD 6.65% and LMT 5.42% (Massive).
themes.for_you: No action. LMT, LHX and GD are 'Accumulate on pullback' and well above their buy zones; wait for a pullback, and no puts at these prices.

themes.name: Fintech and Crypto Rails: Stablecoins, Tokenization, Exchanges
themes.what: Analysts blame North Korea's TraderTraitor unit for the $6.3 billion Binance hack, most of which left Binance wallets in about 20 minutes; Binance reserved over $6.3 billion to cover losses and plans a proof of reserves report by Monday (BBC). COIN fell 12.72% for the week to 143.54, HOOD 10.6% to 84.99 and CRCL 15.6% to 72.54 (Massive), while ARK bought all three on Oct 30 (ARK email).
themes.for_you: No crypto trades. COIN is Avoid and HOOD is Wait. ARK buying is weak evidence next to a falling chart; wait for Binance's reserve report and withdrawals to resume.

themes.name: GLP-1 and obesity
themes.what: Lilly closed at a record 1,417.54 on Oct 30, up 11.31% for the week after its Q3 beat and raise (Massive). ARK sold 17,626 LLY shares in ARKK the same day, about 0.39% of the fund (ARK email).
themes.for_you: No action. LLY is 'Accumulate on pullback', far above its 1,054.91 to 1,229.49 buy zone. ARK's trim is one fund taking profit, not a warning.

themes.name: Healthcare and Medtech: Aging, Heart, Sugar, Hearing, Sight
themes.what: An FDA advisory committee met Oct 30 on Sydnexis's SYD-101, a low dose atropine drop for childhood myopia. There was no vote, and members broadly backed the FDA's concerns about its single Phase III trial and the literature (Pink Sheet, BioWorld). WST held its breakout on Oct 30, closing at 412.62 above the 398.67 pivot, but fell 0.97% on 1.81 times normal volume (Massive).
themes.for_you: No action. COO is left out of both lists: a setback for an atropine drop helps contact lens myopia control a little, but Sydnexis is private and the effect is small. WST is left out too: the breakout holds, but the heavy volume down day is a warning; keep any swing stop under 398.

innovations.name: Defense and Security
innovations.what: Rechecked on the daily rotation. Missile defense production money keeps growing on multiyear terms: L3Harris got seven year contracts of $6.3 billion for THAAD propulsion and $4.7 billion for PAC-3 MSE propulsion, holds a record $53.2 billion backlog and opened a new solid rocket motor plant in Arkansas; it also booked more than $500 million of VAMPIRE counter drone orders (Defence Industry Europe, Oct 30). The US approved a $2.1 billion Patriot sale to Ukraine (Reuters, Oct 30). No stage moves: this is production money for fielded interceptors, while hypersonics and space based defense still wait on tests and the full year budget.
innovations.for_you: No action. LHX (277.61) and LMT (636.95) are 'Accumulate on pullback' and above their buy zones; the orders support the long term case, but wait for a pullback before any buy.

countries.name: Brazil
countries.what: Week one after the election: the Ibovespa fell 18.12%, its worst week since March 2020, and the PTAX dollar rate was R$5.4212 on Oct 30 (Rio Times). In New York EWZ fell 23.78% for the week to 32.46, NU 23.4% to 11.61, ITUB 26.3% to 7.13 and BBD 37.3% to 2.55 (Massive). Polymarket gives 78.4% to a Selic hold on Nov 4; Itau cut its 2027 GDP forecast to 0.5% and raised 2027 inflation to 6.1%.
countries.for_you: No Brazil buys, swings or new puts before the Nov 4 decision. NU is 11.4% under its 13.10 line. If you sold the EWZ Nov 20 $37 put, it is 12.3% in the money; with no verdict, do not roll.

countries.name: Gulf (Saudi Arabia, UAE, Qatar, Iran risk)
countries.what: Brent's December contract expired Oct 30 at $117.64 and January settled at $113.43, capping a 13.6% October (FinanceFeeds). On Oct 31 the Times of Israel carried a report that the US warned Gulf allies of possible strikes on Iran as early as Nov 4, and another that a US delegation would join direct talks in Doha after a breakthrough. Seven OPEC+ members meet online Nov 1 and were expected to hold December output (Reuters sources via FinanceFeeds).
countries.for_you: Swing: XOM and CVX closed above their 2R targets Friday; take the plan and do not add oil names before Nov 4. DAL is inside its buy zone but an oil spike is the risk: no DAL buy or put until after Wednesday.
